plan.gate: The primary policy at one gain must achieve a positive paired lower endpoint against certified wide on both MMLU cohorts, with no increase in lookups, and meet or beat the published split-safe GEPA ceiling at its own cost.
plan.route: Use immediate certification when remaining validation reads cover two certificates in the best case, each costing incumbent passes plus one. Otherwise use the reserved probe batch. Reuse every incumbent validation reply and keep both qualification margins.
plan.scope: Preserve original certified-wide search, qualification prefix, finalist, and case assignments. A finalist has evidence of repair if it passed a validation case the incumbent failed. The paid-only policy blocks qualification without such evidence. The spare-cap policy can seek the evidence on unused validation cases and preserves the original qualification order on admission. Compare both margins and all eight cohorts. Replay the MMLU GEPA attainers.
